instagram.caption:
How many shirts is enough.
The Dresser Drawers in the Kids Bedroom. Folded everyday clothes a child can get themselves dressed from without asking.

What done looks like:
1. One category each
2. Each with a picture label on the drawer front. Socks
3. Underwear standing upright in rows so every pair is visible from above. Every drawer closes with one push
4. No pressing down. Dresser strapped to the wall

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success dresser drawers.
